description: This file defines the 'GraphOperation' class, which represents a node operation within a TensorFlow computation graph. It provides methods to access properties of graph nodes, such as name, type, outputs, shapes, and data types, and manages native handle references for lower-level API interactions.

classes.name: GraphOperation
classes.description: Represents a node operation within a TensorFlow graph, encapsulating native handles and providing methods for retrieving node details.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation node.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the operation node.

methods.name: numOutputs
methods.description: Returns the number of output tensors from the operation.

methods.name: outputListLength
methods.description: Returns the length of a specified output list by name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the native handle.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on graph reference and native handle.

methods.name: inputListLength
methods.description: Returns the length of an input list by name.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the output tensor at the specified index.

methods.name: dtype
methods.description: Returns the data type of the output tensor at the specified index.

methods.name: tensor
methods.description: Throws an exception; tensors are to be fetched via running a session.

methods.name: getUnsafeNativeHandle
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying native handle.
